# Gerardo Castaneda ("Rardo") · Independent Web Studio

> Bespoke, flat-fee one-page websites, direct inbox ordering ledgers, and self-editable owner panels for small businesses in Glennville, Tattnall County, Georgia, and beyond.

## Studio Dossier & Commercial Terms

- **Builder:** Gerardo Castaneda ("Rardo")
- **Station:** Glennville & Reidsville, Tattnall County, Georgia (31.9407° N, 81.9296° W)
- **Languages:** English & Español (Native speaker, born in Siguatepeque, Comayagua, Honduras)
- **Proof-First Guarantee:** Free working mockup built from your real business info before any invoice exists
- **Turnaround:** 7 days (one focused week from mockup approval to live launch)
- **Pricing Model:** Single flat fee named upfront; no monthly developer retainer; 100% client ownership

## Capabilities & Structured Offerings

1. **No. 01 · One-Page Business Websites (`One-Page Business Website`)**
   Mobile-first storefront with what you sell, current hours, street address, and a tap-to-call action bar.
2. **No. 02 · Ordering & Contact Systems (`Ordering & Contact Form System`)**
   Line-item customer order and inquiry ledgers routed straight to the owner's email inbox with 0% platform commission.
3. **No. 03 · Self-Editable Owner Panels (`Self-Editable Website + Admin Panel`)**
   Plain-language admin panel allowing business owners to update prices, stock status, hours, and photos in two minutes without calling a developer.
